parsed.name: 泰克 TDS2024 数字实时示波器
parsed.description: 一款 200 MHz、4 通道数字实时示波器，用于采集、显示和测量电信号波形。该设备可进行触发控制、通道选择、波形数据读取以及频率、最小值、最大值和平均值等即时测量，适用于电子实验与信号调试。
parsed.description_en: A 200 MHz, 4-channel digital real-time oscilloscope used to acquire, display, and measure electrical waveforms. It supports trigger control, channel selection, waveform data readout, and immediate measurements such as frequency, minimum, maximum, and mean, making it suitable for electronics experiments and signal debugging.
